status: development-only burial-state context plan, frozen before any fitted error was inspected
motivation: the coefficient calibration found per-well offsets (mean 278 m/s) that cluster by quadrant; quadrant and lithostratigraphic age are confounded in the cohort, so area-based and unit-based explanations are tested against each other

inputs.windows: the 442 primary windows with context attached by context.py: lithostratigraphic group at the window midpoint from the supplied NPD picks, quadrant and block from the well name, SODIR coordinates

physics: the actual rockVelocity function from src/basin.ts with unchanged coefficients; only the burial-state history passed to it changes

burial_state_offset.positive: exhumation: maximum burial and maximum effective loading are present depth plus delta; current stress stays at present depth
burial_state_offset.negative: undercompaction with overpressure: maximum effective loading and current stress depth are present depth plus delta (floored at zero); maximum geometric burial stays at present depth

M0_global.meaning: one offset for every window; control

M1_quadrant.meaning: one offset per North Sea quadrant

M1b_block.meaning: one offset per quadrant/block; sensitivity to area size

M3_quadrant_plus_group.meaning: additive quadrant and group offsets, fitted by alternation

objective: equal-parent-weighted mean squared error; every unit's offset starts at zero; each offset is fitted by a 25-point scan over its bounds followed by golden-section refinement; two-key models alternate four sweeps

cross_validation.by_well: leave-one-parent-well-out: units without training windows keep offset zero
cross_validation.by_quadrant: leave-one-quadrant-out: tests whether group offsets transfer to an unseen area; area offsets reduce to the untuned law there by construction

report_metrics: bias, MAE and root mean per-parent MSE with equal parent weight; by facies, depth band, quadrant and group; fitted offsets per unit with fold ranges
selection_rule: rank by leave-one-well-out MAE; ties within 5 m/s favor fewer units; record the chosen model as a regional scenario table only if the paired bootstrap interval of (chosen CV MAE minus untuned MAE) excludes zero; an area model that wins does not claim transfer to unseen areas
not_done_here: no coefficient change, no source change, no holdout scoring, no window re-selection, no per-well offsets, no claim that a fitted offset is a measured exhumation or pore pressure
